info.title: AIMO3-High-Difficulty-Tool-Calling-Dataset
info.description:
# AIMO3 High-Difficulty Tool Calling Dataset

We are excited to release a high-quality mathematical reasoning dataset designed to improve large language models on complex problem-solving tasks. This dataset was developed specifically for the AIMO competition and focuses on enhancing reasoning reliability through executable Python tool calls.

---

## Overview

**Dataset Name:**
**AIMO3-High-Difficulty-Tool-Calling-Dataset.jsonl**

**Goal:**
This dataset targets high-difficulty mathematical problems and incorporates Python-based reasoning trajectories to strengthen models’ computational accuracy and logical consistency.

---

## Data Format

Each sample follows a structured JSON schema:

```json
{
  "metadata_infos": {
    "problem": "Original problem",
    "standard": "Reference answer",
    "data_source": "Source (e.g., AoPS competition datasets)",
    "reason_high_with_tool": {
      "count": "Number of samplings (8)",
      "pass": "Number of correct responses",
      "accuracy": "Accuracy rate"
    }
  },
  "text": "Harmony-formatted training text"
}
```

### Key Components

* **metadata_infos** — Stores problem details and sampling statistics
* **text** — Preprocessed using the Harmony format and ready for direct training

No additional preprocessing is required to generate training `input_ids`.

```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(
    "openai/gpt-oss-120b",
    trust_remote_code=True
)

input_ids = tokenizer(data["text"])["input_ids"]
```

---

The final dataset contains approximately **70,000 reasoning trajectories**.

---

## Dataset Construction

The dataset was built through a multi-stage pipeline:

### 1. Source Filtering

* Problems were collected from open mathematical communities such as **Art of Problem Solving (AoPS)**.
* Only questions with answers in the range **[0, 99,999]** were retained to align with the AIMO3 answer distribution.

---

### 2. Multi-Sampling Strategy

* Each problem was sampled **8 times** using **GPT-OSS-120B** in high-reasoning mode.
* All generated solutions include Python tool calls.

---

### 3. Trajectory Selection

We applied different retention strategies based on pass rates:

* **Pass < 4:** keep all reasoning trajectories
* **Pass between 4–7:** retain only trajectories without Python execution failures

This approach balances:

✅ reasoning diversity
✅ execution reliability
✅ problem difficulty

---

## Data Novelty

| Reasoning | Acc |
| --- | --- |
| reason_low_no_tool | 0.304077 |
| reason_low_with_tool | 0.470305 |
| reason_medium_no_tool | 0.579227 |
| reason_medium_with_tool | 0.675028 |
| reason_high_no_tool | 0.757720 |
| reason_high_with_tool | 0.794518 |

Based on the statistics presented in the table above (the data in the table is derived from the Nemotron-Math-v2 dataset), our analysis reveals a key insight:

> Integrating Python tool calls into reasoning significantly improves mathematical accuracy in large language models.

Therefore, this dataset emphasizes **executable reasoning** rather than purely textual chains of thought.

### Additional Filtering

Although sourced from public datasets, extensive curation was performed:

* **Value Range Filtering**
  Ensures alignment with the AIMO3 distribution.

* **Pass Rate Filtering**
  Only problems with ≤7 successful samples were retained to maintain high difficulty.

* **Trajectory Filtering**
  For relatively easier problems, only trajectories with fully correct Python calls were preserved.

---

## Comparison with Nemotron-Math-v2

While NVIDIA’s **Nemotron-Math-v2** provides a similar open dataset, our design differs substantially in reasoning structure.

### ✅ Harmony-Native Format

The dataset is directly compatible with GPT-OSS training pipelines — no preprocessing required.

---

### ✅ Explicit Reasoning Separation

* The reasoning process is stored in structured reasoning content.
* The final response contains only the answer.

![](https://www.googleapis.com/download/storage/v1/b/kaggle-user-content/o/inbox%2F659251%2F98fcc191653188ca976251e2fc296840%2F.png?generation=1770191243410233&alt=media)

This design is particularly beneficial for:

* reasoning model training
* speculative decoding
* reasoning distillation

---

### ✅ Non-Harmony Compatibility

For users who prefer standard chat formatting, the dataset can be converted via:

```
convert_harmony_to_messages.py
```

---

## Format

The dataset is released in **Harmony format** for immediate use with GPT-OSS-120B.

It can also be converted into a standard `messages` format to support mainstream training frameworks.

---

## Performance

This dataset has already demonstrated strong results in the AIMO3 competition.

---

# Training Impact

## 1. Eagle3 Training (Inference Acceleration)

We first used this dataset to train an Eagle3 draft model for speculative decoding.

**Training Code:**
[https://github.com/juemifuji/eagle3-aimo3](https://github.com/juemifuji/eagle3-aimo3)

### Results

✅ Up to **36% inference speedup**

| throughput(gpt-oss-120b) | throughput(gpt-oss-120b-eagle3-aimo3) | speedup | concurrency |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------ | ------- | ----------- |
| 776.514                  | 1059.43                              | 36.40%  | 8           |
| 686.717                  | 956.431                              | 39.30%  | 7           |
| 596.596                  | 851.647                              | 42.80%  | 6           |
| 518.76                   | 680.951                              | 31.30%  | 5           |
| 465.702                  | 657.682                              | 41.20%  | 4           |
| 379.48                   | 541.304                              | 42.60%  | 3           |
| 297.553                  | 422.232                              | 41.90%  | 2           |
| 190.023                  | 268.132                              | 41.10%  | 1           |

*(8-way concurrency, streaming inference, frequent prefill workloads)*

**Model:**
[https://huggingface.co/wenliang1990/gpt-oss-120b-eagle3-aimo3](https://huggingface.co/wenliang1990/gpt-oss-120b-eagle3-aimo3)

---

### Offline IMO Evaluation

On the IMO benchmark:

| Model        | Accuracy |
| ------------ | -------- |
| GPT-OSS-120B | 50%      |
| + Eagle3     | **60%**  |

Results can be reproduced using:

```
test_eagle3.py
```

Online AIMO3 deployment achieved consistent **≥36% acceleration**.

---

## 2. Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)

We also leveraged this dataset for GPT-OSS-120B supervised fine-tuning.

**Training Repository:**
[https://github.com/juemifuji/Megatron-LM-AIMO3](https://github.com/juemifuji/Megatron-LM-AIMO3)

After **5 epochs**:

* IMO first 10 problems:
  **6/10 → 7/10**

We are currently completing **MXFP4 quantization** and plan to deploy the quantized model to further improve real-world AIMO3 performance.

---

## Future Work

Our upcoming efforts include:

* Completing quantized deployment
* Further improving inference efficiency
* Expanding high-difficulty tool-calling data

We hope this dataset helps push the frontier of mathematical reasoning in large language models.
